subject: Re: Partner crediting & lead handoff lifecycle for AxiomOps integration
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire@axiomops.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner opportunity — revenue share + lead registration

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking a look at this — I’m Claire, Partnerships at AxiomOps. We build a developer-focused CI/CD observability product and have a handful of customers asking for a first-class connector into Redwood Inference.

High level ask: we’d like to discuss a commercial framework for an integrations partnership (referral + reseller options). Specifically we want clarity on:
- Lead registration window and what evidence is required
- Commission / rev-share cadence (first year vs renewal)
- Clawback policy for cancellations/refunds
- Operational handoff SLA (demo, POC ownership)

We’ve done this with other vendors and typically: 1) register a lead via spreadsheet & portal; 2) proof of demo or intro within 30 days; 3) 12-month clawback if a customer churns for a refund. But we’re flexible and want to align to Redwood’s partner playbook.

Attaching a short one-pager on the integration use case. Can we get 30 minutes next week to sketch an MOU and leadflow?

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Partnerships Lead, AxiomOps
claire@axiomops.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
(Attachment: AxiomOps_integration_onepager.pdf)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner opportunity — revenue share + lead registration

Hi Claire — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the overview and the one-pager. We’re interested in exploring an integrations partnership with AxiomOps.

Initial thoughts from the partnerships side (quick, to unblock scheduling):
- Lead registration: we prefer a time-limited claim window tied to a clearer evidence set (contact + demo record + HubSpot lead ID). Proposed default: 90-day registration validity from the date of registration.
- Commission structure: common pattern we use is a front-loaded split to incent early adoption — e.g., 60/40 partner/redwood on first-year gross revenue, then 20/80 on renewals (subject to customer retention thresholds).
- Clawback: standard 12-month clawback on refunds/credits tied to invoiced revenue; prorated by month.
- Handoff SLA: partner registers lead → Redwood to acknowledge within 2 business days → assign SDR/SE within 3 business days for technical alignment.

What I’d like from you before a sync: a short MOU draft (even bullet points) and a sample registered-lead export (we have a template we can share). I’m looping Camila (partner operations) and Karthik (commercial) to weigh in.

If that sounds ok, I can schedule a 30-minute call for next Tue/Wed.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: MDP_outline_v1.pdf)

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner opportunity — revenue share + lead registration

Looping in ops/comp here — a few operational guardrails to consider before we sign anything: 

- Registration authenticity: require partner-provided contact + date of first intro; lead must be unique to partner (HubSpot dupe check).
- Demo requirement: to qualify for referral credit, partner or Redwood must record a demo in our portal within 45 days of registration. If Redwood runs the pilot, co-sell crediting rules should be clarified (we often reserve higher credit when partner provides the lead but Redwood owns the POC).
- Clawback nuance: for trial-to-paid conversions, clawbacks should be tied to net revenue recognized (exclude trial credits). Also consider a 6-month partial clawback window for early churn (to reduce partner risk).

I suggest we default to 60/40 first-year split but allow Karthik to propose a variant tied to ARR thresholds (e.g., >$50k ARR gets 65/35). I’ll pull our lead registration template and share.

-Camila
Camila Reyes
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Huang <claire@axiomops.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partners@axiomops.com
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner opportunity — revenue share + lead registration

Thanks Lauren / Camila — helpful. I’m attaching a short draft MOU and a populated lead-registration export so you can see our record format. A few counter-proposals from our side:

- Lead claim window: we prefer 120 days due to longer enterprise procurement cycles; we can accept 90 days if demo logging is required.
- Commission: proposed 70/30 partner/redwood on first 6 months of paid invoices, then 50/50 for year 1 remaining months, and 25/75 on renewals thereafter. We prefer monthly payout cadence.
- Clawback: 12 months, but reduce prorated clawback to 6 months if the customer upgrades seats above baseline within 90 days.
- Handoff SLA: AxiomOps requests Redwood to respond to registered leads within 3 business days and to provide a named SE for technical calls within 7 business days for any lead that meets our PQL threshold.

Attachments: AxiomOps_MOU_draft_v1.pdf, lead_registration_template.xlsx

Let us know if you want us to redline your MOU or if you prefer Redwood to author a short SOW-style MOU. We are available for a call Tue (15 Jun) or Wed (16 Jun) afternoon PT.

Best,
Claire
(Attachment: AxiomOps_MOU_draft_v1.pdf; lead_registration_template.xlsx)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@axiomops.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner opportunity — revenue share & lead handoff lifecycle for AxiomOps integration

Claire — thanks for the attachments and the thoughtful counters. Quick summary and next steps from our side so we have a shared record before the call: 

Summary of agreed points (proposed)
- Lead registration: accept 90-day claim by default if partner provides contact + demo log + HubSpot ID. If AxiomOps can provide procurement timelines showing >90-day cycles for a lead, Redwood will consider 120-day exceptions case-by-case.
- Commission: propose a blended first-year: 65/35 partner/redwood for first 6 months (to balance your ask and our ops constraints), 50/50 for months 7–12, renewals 25/75. Payouts quarterly (we can do monthly for >$50k gross deals).
- Clawback: 12-month clawback on refunds/credits; prorated monthly. If the customer upgrades >25% ARR within first 90 days, we reduce clawback exposure to 6 months (as you proposed).
- Handoff SLA: Redwood will acknowledge registrations within 2 business days and provide an SE resource within 5 business days for PQL leads (we can agree to 7 days for enterprise handoffs).
- Evidence & gating: registration requires contact info, HubSpot lead ID, and demo log. We will reject duplicate registrations and notify partner with reason code.

Operational asks from Redwood ops
- Please populate the lead_registration_template with at least three historical examples so we can validate dupe logic and PQL thresholds.
- If Redwood runs the pilot, we’ll propose a co-sell uplift (an additional 10% partner credit) if partner originated the intro.

Next steps
1) Lauren to schedule 30-min call for Tue 15 Jun 14:00 PT (send calendar invite) — agenda: MOU redlines, registration schema, payout cadence.
2) AxiomOps to return populated lead template + any procurement timelines.
3) Camila/Karthik to draft a short (1-page) MOU reflecting the blended split above for Claire to redline.

If that aligns, I’ll send a calendar invite and a one-page MOU draft by EOD Mon.

Thanks — looking forward to building this out.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: Redwood_lead_registration_template.xlsx)
